summary: Verified 1s Postgres timeouts, breaker open after 5 /ready failures, 4ms 503 fallback, jittered retries 97ms/189ms, and half-open close on a probe breaker. Live docker start postgres was not possible.
evidence: External calls: only Postgres on the request path; connect_timeout=1, statement_timeout=1000ms, pool_timeout=1. No outbound HTTP. Redis unused in handlers.
Open: 10x GET /ready statuses all 503; timings first five ~4.07-4.13s then 0.004s x5; circuit_state_change to open at fail_max=5; circuit_open_fallback on remaining.
Jitter: retry delays [0.0978, 0.1899] seconds, delay_ms 97 and 189, not exact 100/200.
Close: probe breaker PROBE_TRIAL ok and PROBE_STATE_AFTER_SUCCESS closed. Limitation: no docker start postgres in this environment.
